skill_name: Explain how the movie The Matrix presents a world where technology controls our lives.
workflow: The movie The Matrix presents a world where technology controls our lives in a number of ways. Firstly, the main character, Neo, wakes up to discover that a computer program is controlling every aspect of his reality; even the people he knows and loves are part of the computer system. This implies that technology has taken away our ability to have true control over our lives and our reality is actually just a simulation.
